about.description: FX perpetual on Flash Trade tracking British Pound (GBP) versus the US dollar, with pricing referencing Pyth FX feeds. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC on Solana, giving users synthetic exposure to British Pound/USD price movement without holding either currency as cash. Delisted 2026-09-08: Flash Trade entered an orderly wind-down (deadline 2026-09-02). Protocol-wide OI $36k; all RWA markets at zero long and short; dailyVolumeInUsd 0.
